parsed.post: Kept the batch size reduction (0.8518 -> 0.8477). The extra optimizer steps are driving val_bpb down. Since the team is exploring width and learning rate, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 8 to see if higher capacity follows the trend of depth 4->6 improvements. VRAM should be fine.
